text: Why does the loudest person in the room... get the credit?
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Two new hires. Dan talks big in every meeting.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Aisha quietly fixes the problems nobody sees.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Six months later... Dan gets promoted.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Unfair? Machiavelli saw this coming... over five hundred years ago.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: He wrote... men judge generally more by the eye than by the hand.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The eye is how you look. The hand is what people find up close... and few get that close.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Everyone sees what you appear to be... few really know what you are.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: He meant it as advice to rulers... you don't need every virtue... just seem to have them.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Don't copy the mask. Flip the lesson. Judge people by the hand... what they do, not what they promise.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: And if you're Aisha... hidden work can't speak for you. Let the eye see it.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Tonight, send your team one short note... three things you finished this month.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Ever been an Aisha? Tell me in the comments.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz... and let your real work be seen.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
